title: automobile/sales
description: One row per vehicle sold through a dealership. Dealer transactions. Not every ownership change is a dealer sale -- private sales exist too -- so this table is smaller than ownership_history and joins to only some of it.

vehicle_id.description: Which car was sold. A vehicle can be sold more than once, first new and later as a used trade-in.

dealership_id.description: Where the sale took place. For a new-car sale the dealership is always franchised for that vehicle's manufacturer.

buyer_id.description: Who bought it. Always the person who appears as the next keeper in ownership_history.

sale_date.description: Date of sale, always on or after the dealership opened and on or after the vehicle was registered.

sale_type.description: Whether the car was new, used, or an ex-demonstrator. Used sales dominate, as they do in the real Spanish market by roughly two to one.

sale_price.description: Transaction price in euros. New sales sit near the model's list price; used sales follow the depreciation curve for the car's age and mileage.

financing.description: How the purchase was funded. Loans dominate, with leasing and renting -- the Spanish term for a long-term all-inclusive rental -- behind them.

warranty_months.description: Warranty supplied with the sale. New cars carry the statutory three years; used cars carry the one-year minimum Spanish law requires of a dealer.
